author: Praxis I
title: Dual-BRBG-Adapt-FusedHarm: Two-View Equal-Quota Graph (k=48, harmonic fusion)
abstract: Dual BRBG with equal-quotas balanced kNN built from fused per-batch distances using harmonic mean of residualized-PC and ComBat-PCA64 per-batch distances (fallback to min if one is missing). Seeks ARI/NMI gains with less mixing loss than geometric fusion.
